scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:prod: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/intel-suite run build
scripts.start:prod: NODE_ENV=production DATABASE_POOL_MAX=1 PUBLIC_PORTAL_CONCURRENCY=1 PUBLIC_PORTAL_ROTATION_BATCH_SIZE=3 WEB_INTELLIGENCE_AI_CANDIDATE_LIMIT=20 MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 node --max-old-space-size=224 --max-semi-space-size=8 ./api-server/dist/index.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./api-server" --filter "./intel-suite" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
